mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, metric_name as name, quantity, unit, data_origin as dataOrigin, sort_order as sortOrder from report_workload where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} order by sort_order, id
mapper.delete: delete from report_workload where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.insert: insert into report_workload ( dept_id, report_id, metric_name, quantity, unit, data_origin, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{deptId}, #{reportId}, #{name}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{dataOrigin}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
